scientific.integrity: The source QSGD quantizer is specialized directly at precision parameter \(s=1\). Its exact coordinate second moments are inserted into the diagonal quadratic identity before any variance upper bound is used.
limitations: Diagonal positive-definite quadratics in the quantizer coordinate basis.
One worker, deterministic gradients, scalar constant steps, and QSGD precision parameter \(s=1\).
The universal frontier concerns conditional expected objective descent, not almost-sure monotonicity.
No claim for stochastic-gradient noise, error feedback, momentum, multiple workers, or higher quantization precision.

title: One-level QSGD has a sharp curvature-profile descent frontier
